cases.name: Chelsea Ellen Bruck
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Her favorite pastimes included: watching movies, especially musicals; listening to music, of which Queen was her favorite band; enjoyed playing videogames, including Final Fantasy VIII; and her favorite television show, Doctor Who. She also enjoyed reading and baking, and had a special love for her dog and cats. She was raised very close to her siblings and loved being a part of the “Bruck girls.”"

Her favorite color was purple. She worked at Olga's Kitchen at the Mall of Monroe and was planning to attend planned Monroe Community College to pursue a culinary degree.
cases.narrative: On 4/24/2015, her body was found by someone walking on a private wooded lot in nearby Carleton. The medical examiner testified that they also found two of Bruck's teeth were chipped, which they said would be a part of possible blows to the central portion of her jaw. She was wearing a Halloween costume because she attended a party and the shoulder straps as well as the crouch panel had been cut out or torn.
